highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156 improves runtime efficiency while updating Android rendering and Apple platform support.
highlights_body: The release reduces allocations in image and text processing, fixes front-buffered stream retention, and bundles required WebGPU and HarfBuzz native code more reliably.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows the display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh to provide smoother, more consistent rendering.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing allocate less
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel copies and HarfBuzz feature-string processing avoid unnecessary allocations, reducing overhead in repeated image and text operations.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data
bullets.detail: Corrects front-buffered stream retention so buffered data can be released when it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Linux bundles its required HarfBuzz functions
bullets.detail: Binds the bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux, improving the reliability of the native dependency setup.

bullets.lead: WebGPU support is included in the native library
bullets.detail: Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so native consumers receive the WebGPU implementation with the library.
Updates Apple platform deployment minimums to align the supported target range with current platform requirements.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Linux HarfBuzz binding improvements and more reliable Blazor CPU sample rendering tests
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the WebGPU implementation into the native SkiaSharp library
